summary: This article is about the boss in Selene's Web and Lair of Maarselok. For the boss in Infinite Archive, see Selene (Infinite Archive). For the set, see Selene (set). Selene is a Changeling priestess of Shagrath found in Selene's Web, serving as the matriarch of the Bosmer there. She has a chance to drop either Selene's Scepter or Webcutter. She is also the namesake of the Selene set and the basis of a trophy and bust. At the conclusion of the dungeon, her soul is bound by Warlock Carindon, and he traps her spirit to research it for his future experiments. Selene returns in the Lair of Maarselok, having been subject to various experiments and painful bindings by Carindon. He brought her spirit and carcass to the Tenmar Valley until Maarselok awoke. The Stags of Z'en have enlisted Carindon's assistance to stop Maarselok, requiring him to unbind Selene at times to halt the effects of the Azureblight. Carindon worries that by loosening his hold on Selene, he risks allowing Maarselok to influence and corrupt her. Selene will use her magic to assist you and cleanse your group members of the Azureblight.
